title: promote(ai-lab): DeepSeek V4 Fast → Flash as production primary model
head: promote-dsv4-flash
body:
Promotes DeepSeek V4 from 'almost prod ready' (amber) to 'production — primary model' (emerald).

- Renames V4 Fast → V4 Flash (correct model branding)
- Changes status from amber 'almost prod ready' to emerald 'production — primary model'
